messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we still have noisy DB connection alerts firing during non-peak hours. Can we lock down a plan for quiet-hours suppression and dedupe?

sam: Agree. Saw ~120 alerts last night between 1–4am, mostly from the same service cluster. We should avoid paging on those unless they cross a higher severity threshold.

joni: Proposed approach: 1) add a quiet-hours rule (00:30–05:00 UTC) that suppresses P2s, 2) bump the connection-failure threshold from 5->12 for P1/P2 split, 3) enable dedupe by source IP + error fingerprint.

maya: That sounds reasonable. Can we keep a metric-based fallback so we still page if overall error rate spikes? (e.g., if >200 errors/min)

liam: +1 for metric fallback. Also recommend annotating alerts with last-success timestamp so dedupe doesn't hide a slow steady failure.

ops-bot: Reminder: runbook link updated by @maya: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/db-connections

sam: Quick config snippet I tested locally: ```yaml
alert: DBConnectionFailures
expr: sum(rate(db_conn_errors[1m])) by (cluster)
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: p2
annotations:
  summary: "DB connections failing ({{ $labels.cluster }})"
```
Add dedupe labels: `fingerprint = cluster + instance_ip + error_type`

joni: Timeline proposal: - PR with rule changes by EOD Thu - deploy to staging Fri morning - monitor for 48h - promote to prod Mon if green. Owners: sam (rule PR), maya (runbook updates), liam (monitor + rollback plan).

maya: i'm ok with that timeline. can we also add a daily alert count dashboard tile so we can eyeball noise immediately after deploy?

liam: i'll add a Grafana panel and a short pager duty suppression dashboard. tagging in the dashboard role.

sam: one more detail: dedupe window = 30m to avoid repeated pages for the same root cause. Thoughts?

joni: 30m seems fine for non-prod clusters. For prod clusters let's make it 10m and rely on severity to escalate.

maya: action items recap: sam -> PR for threshold + dedupe labels; maya -> update runbook with quiet-hours and fallback metrics; liam -> dashboard + monitoring job; joni -> merge policy + prod/perf exceptions. target: PR merged by EOD Thu.

liam: noted. i'll create the dashboard card and add alert counts by cluster.

ops-bot: @channel Reminder: on-call rotation for Fri -> @sam, Sat -> @joni, Sun -> @maya.

sam: will draft the PR now. ping me if you want to pair on the alert expr.

maya: thanks all. we'll reconvene monday 10am post-deploy to verify noise reduction. :thumbsup:

joni: ACK. I'll schedule the follow-up meeting and invite the triage list.

liam: FYI i'll add a simple script to auto-close suppressed duplicate alerts after 35m so our alert backlog doesn't pile up.```
